seo.title: Villa NATALIA – Deluxe Four-Bedroom Villa | AEOLINA Collection
seo.description: Villa NATALIA is a 200 m² deluxe villa with 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, private pool, full kitchen, balcony/terrace, and garden & mountain views. Flat-screen TV with streaming, free Wi-Fi, A/C, soundproofing. No smoking.

hero.title: Villa NATALIA
hero.intro: A deluxe 200 m² four-bedroom villa with private pool, expansive terrace and tranquil garden & mountain views. Featuring a fully equipped kitchen, four modern bathrooms with walk-in showers, and thoughtful comforts for families and groups seeking privacy and ease in Corfu.
